flows.name: 包B-渲染真实生效-数字格式-暗色主题-单列排布与阅读顺序

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 120; i += 1) { if (typeof isBusy === 'function' && isBusy()) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); continue; } const sel = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]')).filter((s) => !s.disabled).pop(); if (sel) { const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find((o) => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (opt) { sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); } return false; })()

(() => { const dom = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).map(e => e.getAttribute('data-region-id')); const def = (session.definition?.regions || []).map(r => r.id); const common = dom.filter(id => def.includes(id)); const expected = def.filter(id => dom.includes(id)); return common.length >= 3 && JSON.stringify(common) === JSON.stringify(expected); })()
